title: Get workflow definition
description: Read one page of a saved workflow definition: its blocks in order (type, label, configuration such as recorded selectors, field roles, value shapes, variable names, record limits) and the edges touching them. Use it to explain what a run did or why a field read nothing.
guidance: Read-only; credentials, physical file paths, session-group bindings and URL user-info are replaced by [redacted], and long values are cut. Page with nodeOffset / nextNodeOffset; filter by nodeType (for example get-text). A workflow saved by a scrape wizard with a collect hint also carries detectionProvenance (whether the hint-steered detection, tier D2, produced its source).

workflowId.description: Opaque workflow identifier returned by dsagent.workflows.list or dsagent.wizard.save.

nodeOffset.description: Zero-based position of the first block of the page among the matching blocks; defaults to 0. Pass nextNodeOffset to continue.

nodeLimit.description: Most blocks returned in this page; defaults to 20. A page also stops before its size exceeds the result budget.

nodeType.description: Optional block type to keep, for example get-text, attribute-value, event-click or save-to-local-db.

inputSchema.description: Workflow and page of its definition to read.

definitionVersion.description: Definition version the page was read from, when the backend reports one.

matchedNodeCount.description: Blocks matching nodeType (all blocks when no filter was given).

nodes.description: Blocks of this page in definition order.

nodeId.description: Block identifier inside this workflow definition; edges refer to it.

index.description: Position of the block in the whole definition.

type.description: Block type, for example go-to, get-text, attribute-value, event-click, scrape-record-limit.

label.description: Block label shown in the designer.

config.description: Block configuration as saved, redacted and bounded: credentials, physical paths and session-group bindings read [redacted]; strings over 2000 characters, arrays over 100 items and nesting deeper than 8 levels are cut.

truncated.description: Some configuration value was cut to the bounds.

edges.description: Edges that start or end at a block of this page.

sourceHandle.description: Output handle of the source block, when it has several (for example a loop body or fallback).

targetHandle.description: Input handle of the target block, when named.

hasMore.description: More matching blocks follow this page.

nextNodeOffset.description: nodeOffset for the next page, present when hasMore is true.

redactedValueCount.description: How many values on this page were replaced by [redacted].

used.description: A collect hint was set in the scrape wizard that saved this workflow.

steered.description: A detect-with-ai for that hint ranked the detected sources.

sourceSteered.description: The source this workflow collects is one the AI model ranked or found for the hint.

collectHint.description: The collect hint of the scrape wizard that saved this workflow.

detectionTier.description: Present when the hint-steered detection (failure-endpoint fallback tier D2) produced the collected source; a run of this workflow that passes is recorded with "tier D2".

detectionProvenance.description: How the collected source was detected; present only for a workflow saved by a scrape wizard with a collect hint (dsagent.wizard.start collectHint or values.collectHint). Same on every page.

outputSchema.description: One redacted, bounded page of a workflow definition.
